description: SharePoint Online is Microsoft's cloud collaboration and document management service for sites, lists, libraries, and intranet content in Microsoft 365. Organizations use it to store files, manage content, and automate site and tenant administration.
summary: sharepoint.com exposes a tenant-scoped SharePoint REST API at `https://{tenant}.sharepoint.com/_api` and a PowerShell-based SharePoint Online Management Shell for admin automation; both require Microsoft Entra-issued credentials.
